articles.summary: CALGARY, Alberta, Jan. 14, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Enerflex Ltd. (TSX: EFX) (NYSE: EFXT) (“Enerflex” or the “Company”) plans to release its financial results and operating highlights for the year ended December 31, 2025, on Thursday, February 26, 2026 prior to market open.
articles.title: Enerflex Ltd. Announces Timing of Fourth Quarter Financial and Operational Results
